title: Historic Mansion Dolly Loft Near Broadway
description:
Experience Nashville in this charming Dolly-inspired loft inside a beautifully restored historic mansion just a block off of iconic Music Row. Perfect for bachlorettes, girls’ trips and weekend getaways, this stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bath retreat sleeps up to 6 and blends vintage character with modern comfort. Minutes from Broadway, The Gulch, Vanderbilt, top restaurants, live music, shopping and Nashville’s best attractions, it’s the perfect home base for your Music City adventure.

The space
✨ Nashville Dolly's Glam Loft | Music Row Boutique Stay Near Broadway

Experience Nashville in true superstar style at this glamorous boutique loft nestled inside a beautifully restored historic mansion on iconic Music Row. Inspired by Nashville’s music scene and designed with girls’ trips, bachelorette weekends and bestie getaways in mind, this stylish retreat offers the perfect blend of historic charm and modern luxury.

From IG-worthy photo moments to beautifully curated interiors, every detail has been designed to make your stay unforgettable. Whether you’re getting ready for a night on Broadway, relaxing after a day of exploring, or enjoying coffee before heading out, you’ll feel right at home.

Located just minutes from Broadway, The Gulch, Midtown, Vanderbilt, Belmont University, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, and Nashville’s top restaurants, rooftop bars, shopping, and live music, you’ll be in the heart of Music City while enjoying the character and elegance of historic Music Row.

Sleeping Arrangements

Sleeps 6

* 3 Queen beds
* 2 Queen floor mattresses

Bedroom 1

* 3 Queen Beds (1 Queen bed and Queen over Queen bunkbed)
* Closet
* Nightstands
* Luggage rack
* Make-up station with 3 separate lighted mirrors

Bathroom

* Shower/Tub Combo
* Plush towels
* Makeup washcloths
* Makeup wipes
* Shampoo
* Conditioner
* Body wash
* Hand soap
* Hair dryer
* Starter toilet paper

Living Room

* Sofa
* Two accent chairs
* Smart TV
* Designer décor
* Cozy throw blankets
* Perfect space to relax before your night out

Fully Stocked Kitchen

Everything you need to cook, snack, or celebrate:

* Dining table and chairs
* Refrigerator & freezer
* Oven & cooktop
* Microwave
* Toaster
* Coffee maker with starter coffee supplies
* Wine glasses
* Cookware
* Dishes
* Silverware

Included Amenities

* Free parking for one vehicle
* High-speed Wi-Fi
* Washer & dryer
* Laundry detergent
* Iron & ironing board

Starter supplies are provided for your convenience, including coffee, paper towels (2), toilet paper (3), shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.

Outdoor Space

Relax on the charming patio featuring:

* String lights
* Comfortable cushioned seating
* A peaceful place to unwind after exploring Nashville

For Your Safety

Exterior security cameras monitor the parking area and front entrance only.

Whether you’re celebrating a bride-to-be, planning a girls’ getaway, attending a concert, visiting Vanderbilt or Belmont, or simply looking for an upscale stay near Broadway, this glamorous loft offers the perfect home base for an unforgettable Nashville experience.
